messages:
alex: hey runtime team — quick ask before we lock launch numbers. can we run a short smoke rerun with a cleaned payload set? goal: validate p95/p50 latency, coldstart heatmap, and embedding rerank stability across quantized variants. need raw traces + tag 'mktg-rerun-1716'.

maria: +1. scope: 3 model variants (fp16 baseline, int8, int4), 2 sequence-length cohorts (short: <128, long: 2048+), and the embed->rerank end-to-end latency. also include query diversity seed.

runtime-bot: rerun request created: RR-1716 by alex. estimated ETA: pending eng confirmation.

jordan: can do. two quick clarifications: (1) what's the exact sample set / seed? (2) do you want warmup traffic (prefix caching) before measuring coldstarts? we can script warmup n=3 per pod.

alex: sample set = cleaned_marketing_cohort_v2.json (we removed PII and filter long HTML). seed=42. yes include warmup=3 for the warm baseline, *and* capture full coldstart trace after an idle of 10m. label runs: "coldstart" and "warmed".

sam: for quantization, confirm runtime variants: qint8-fast and qint4-compact? want to ensure fallback to fp16 is logged when perf regressions occur.

maria: exactly — qint8 and qint4. include fp16 control. if tokenization or generation truncation happens, capture the prompt/id.

jordan: ok logging plan: we will attach per-request metadata: model_variant, cohort, run_label, seed, pod_id, warmup_count. example annotation we will add to traces:

```
{"run":"mktg-rerun-1716","variant":"qint8","seed":"42","label":"coldstart"}
```

tara: blocking question: when do you need results? we have a couple of high-priority infra jobs today.

maria: need a summarized artifact for the webinar dry-run in ~48h. full raw traces can be delivered later but summary metrics+sample artifacts needed within 48h.

jordan: ack — we'll prioritize a smoke sweep for the short cohort first, then long cohort overnight. estimate: short cohort within 6h, long cohort + quantized within 30h.

alex: perfect. one more ask — can you include a tiny repro package (3 sample requests for each cohort) we can use in the press deck if numbers look good? nothing dataset-sensitive, just representative.

sam: yes we'll export a minimal artifact set and a `run_manifest.json` with hashes.

maria: please also add a small note about any prewarming we did (how many warmup tokens) and whether KV cache persisted across calls. marketing needs that to qualify latency claims.

jordan: will do. tagging internal ticket RR-1716 and posting results in #marketing when ready.

alex: thanks!! :thumbsup:

maria: appreciate it — ping if you hit snags.

jordan: started the short-cohort smoke now — progress updates in RR-1716.
